metadata.versionNote: Baseline results, late code-reviewed deltas and independent verification runs refer to separate source snapshots. A verification overrides only its explicit catalog IDs; other entries retain their earlier evidence. No passes are reassigned to a later build.
metadata.sourceSnapshotNote: Imported historical audit of a hash-identified working-tree snapshot. The recorded HEAD alone does not identify all audited source bytes. This import verifies catalogue integrity, not the current NeoFlash implementation.
metadata.sourceWorkingTreeNote: Active editor/import development in main chat; audit only, no application source edits. Source hashes define the assessed revision.
metadata.browserMatrix: Only the visibility scenario in actual in-app browser; Chromium/WebKit/Firefox/Safari matrix not performed.
metadata.lateReviewExecutionPolicy: Read-only delta review. Baseline test passes and browser observations are not assigned to the modified sources. No fresh suite was run after these concurrent changes.

rules.title: Architectural absence of platform libraries
rules.reason: Bounded per-handler AS frontend exposes only its accepted core calls and small display proxy. No native Flash/AIR/Flex/component class library, project resolver/linker or generic VM is bundled. Authored NeoFlash geometry/events are not arbitrary callable Flash APIs. This is an architectural absence inference, not an individual execution test.
rules.limitations: Architectural inference; declarations were not individually executed.

rules.title: Accepted operators use JavaScript value/coercion semantics
rules.reason: Arithmetic, comparison, equality, truth conversion, typeof and untyped writes emit the corresponding JavaScript operation. Selected AS3 named-binding coercions are separate; no AVM1/AVM2 value model or player-version dispatch is present. typeof on a host display-object proxy is not a compiler-level MovieClip type test.
rules.limitations: static inspection of snapshot plus explicitly listed Node compiler probes; no original Flash or browser differential verification

rules.title: AS3 typed slots are enforced only on bare names, and handler defaults are late
rules.reason: var count:int=0; this.count=2147483648; observed=count compiles and yields 2147483648. before=count; var count:int yields undefined before declaration, 0 afterwards. Function-local int defaults are correctly established at entry in the selected probe. AS2 annotations are erased. Object/Array/custom annotations are rejected, even though corresponding literals can be used untyped.
rules.limitations: static inspection of snapshot plus explicitly listed Node compiler probes; no original Flash or browser differential verification

rules.title: Core conversion functions are forwarded to host JavaScript
rules.reason: AS2 parseInt("0777") and Number("0777") compile and both return 777 in Node. The selected Adobe AS2 parseInt example specifies 511; its Number reference also specifies octal interpretation of leading-zero strings. No target-player version parameter exists in compile(Script).
rules.limitations: static inspection of snapshot plus explicitly listed Node compiler probes; no original Flash or browser differential verification

rules.title: Whitelisted core methods are native JavaScript calls, with a confirmed documented range mismatch
rules.reason: Calls are permitted by method spelling and forwarded to the receiver. AS3 Number.toFixed(21) returns a 21-digit fraction and does not enter catch(RangeError), whereas the Adobe contract permits 0..20 and specifies RangeError outside it. Receiver-specific argument coercion, range/errors and full method semantics are not implemented by the allowlist.
rules.limitations: static inspection of snapshot plus explicitly listed Node compiler probes; no original Flash or browser differential verification

rules.title: 18 Math methods per language have proven routing, not full Math compatibility
rules.reason: Unshadowed Math resolves to the JS global and exactly the 18 listed methods pass the call gate. Calls have no AS-specific argument adapters; random state and transcendental edge cases are not validated against Flash.
rules.limitations: static inspection of snapshot plus explicitly listed Node compiler probes; no original Flash or browser differential verification

rules.title: Known native constants and Array/String length are available through proven receivers
rules.reason: Literal constants emit directly; Math/Number resolve to native globals. Probes read Math.PI and Number static numeric values; array length truncation works and an astral-character String.length is 2 UTF-16 units. Other Math constant reads follow the same global-property route. Read-only/write/type/coercion behavior is not fully compared against Flash.
rules.limitations: static inspection of snapshot plus explicitly listed Node compiler probes; no original Flash or browser differential verification

rules.title: Grouping and comments are parsed with bounded resource guards
rules.reason: Line/block comments and grouping are lexed/parsed; unclosed comments and excessive token/expression/statement nesting yield diagnostics. This is a syntactic subset assertion only.
rules.limitations: static inspection of snapshot plus explicitly listed Node compiler probes; no original Flash or browser differential verification

rules.title: Array/object/string literals and property access have only native JS object semantics
rules.reason: Dense arrays, object literals with static keys, strings, dot/index reads/writes are emitted as JS. Sparse array syntax is rejected; arbitrary properties are not schema-validated. Property access alone does not prove that a Flash property exists in host/runtime. Lone UTF-16 surrogate property names are rejected.
rules.limitations: static inspection of snapshot plus explicitly listed Node compiler probes; no original Flash or browser differential verification

rules.title: Structured control flow has native lowering and targeted executable fixtures
rules.reason: Blocks, if/else, while/do-while, classic for, switch strict matching/fallthrough, break/continue are implemented. AS3 labels resolve only enclosing targets and do not cross function boundaries. This status covers control structure; expression conversion remains C01. AS2 labels are intentionally rejected.
rules.limitations: static inspection of snapshot plus explicitly listed Node compiler probes; no original Flash or browser differential verification

rules.title: Functions, lexical locals and closures exist within a restricted receiver/call model
rules.reason: Direct function declarations are hoisted; local var defaults and closure capture are implemented. AS3 top-level declarations bind this to the frame owner. Explicit this inside AS2 or nested/expression functions is rejected. Handler bare names become instance fields, local bindings use lexical JS variables. AS3 exact arity checks throw JS TypeError; defaults/rest/arguments and block function declarations are unsupported. Callable member discovery requires same resolved static receiver path within a script; computed calls and alias inference are rejected.
rules.limitations: static inspection of snapshot plus explicitly listed Node compiler probes; no original Flash or browser differential verification

rules.title: Synchronous exceptions and selected Error facades implement a bounded subset
rules.reason: AS3 throws raw values, ordered catches use primitive/core Error predicates, catch scopes are lexical and finally remains a native construct. AS2 explicit throws use branded envelopes; native JS/host errors bypass AS2 catch. AS2 catch supports only untyped or Error and rejects shadowing/catch closures. Arbitrary constructors/classes, boxed/custom catch identity, error codes, stack traces and cross-language interoperability are incomplete.
rules.limitations: static inspection of snapshot plus explicitly listed Node compiler probes; no original Flash or browser differential verification

rules.title: Class/project-source/type-resolution pipeline is absent
rules.reason: Compiler API compiles one synchronous frame/object function body. Class/package/interface/import/accessor/visibility syntax and general new are not supported; selected Error constructors are the explicit exception. No project source units, linker or inheritance/interface/type registry exists here.
rules.limitations: static inspection of snapshot plus explicitly listed Node compiler probes; no original Flash or browser differential verification

rules.title: Enumeration, dynamic-object operations and general type tests are absent
rules.reason: for..in/for each, with, delete, in/instanceof/is/as are rejected. Object.hasOwnProperty/watch/unwatch/valueOf and Function.call/apply do not pass the built-in call gate unless authored explicitly as user members. Plain JS prototype reads/writes can pass property syntax but are not an AVM prototype implementation and are not classified here as supported.
rules.limitations: static inspection of snapshot plus explicitly listed Node compiler probes; no original Flash or browser differential verification

rules.title: Basic constructor/cast/type surfaces remain unavailable despite literals and primitive annotations
rules.reason: int()/uint(), AS2 int(), Array()/Object() and new Array/Object/Number/String/Boolean/int/uint are not accepted as built-ins; Array/Object annotations are rejected. Array.splice/sort/sortOn are outside the call allowlist. Dense literals and annotation-only int/uint coercion do not make these APIs implemented.
rules.limitations: static inspection of snapshot plus explicitly listed Node compiler probes; no original Flash or browser differential verification

rules.title: Namespaces/E4X and AS regular-expression literals are rejected
rules.reason: No XML/XMLList/namespace expression model, E4X lowering or AS RegExp literal parser exists. JavaScript handlers can use JS RegExp but that is not automatic preservation of AS source semantics.

rules.title: Additional documented syntax remains rejected, not silently translated
rules.reason: Comma exists as list punctuation but not the comma expression operator. Sparse array holes, unary void, legacy AS2 word operators, directives, direct on/onClipEvent wrappers, arguments and AS3 rest/default parameters are absent. Some legacy features need player-version gating rather than unconditional support.

rules.reason: Dense arrays/objects and primitive values exist; Number/String/Boolean/Math route to JS globals in accepted expressions. These representations cover selected members only. rules.title: Authored handler lifecycle
rules.reason: New placements queue authored Load handlers; frame entry queues frame scripts; ticks queue authored EnterFrame handlers; clicks bubble authored handlers from leaf through ancestor placements. Dispatch skips stale lifetime/source/frame entries and enforces a 4096 event budget.
rules.limitations: Only four serialized event kinds (load, click, enter_frame, frame). Order is explicitly NeoFlash initial semantics, not Flash verified. Assigning AS2 onEnterFrame is silently custom state and is never invoked (separate finding). No dynamically registered listeners, capture/priority/default prevention or stop propagation. AS3 event bindings are not automatically available in lowered scripts.

rules.title: Eventdispatcher and graphics
rules.reason: Proxy exposes no EventDispatcher methods or Graphics object. addEventListener and graphics.beginFill are rejected with an unknown API diagnostic by the limited AS frontend.
rules.limitations: Do not infer full Graphics absence from authored geometry support: rectangles/ellipses/paths can render, but runtime drawing API is absent.

rules.title: Instance navigation and frame queries
rules.reason: root/_root and parent/_parent return proxies; currentFrame and totalFrames return shared model data. Unmapped reads search custom state, then direct child by authored name. Proxy identity is scoped to JSON instance-ID path plus placement lifetime.
rules.limitations: No getChildByName/getChildAt/addChild/removeChild/DisplayObjectContainer implementation. The root is the authored root scene; AS3 Stage/root loader semantics are absent. Legacy slash paths, _levelN, target-path string resolution and dynamic display tree are not provided.

rules.title: Numeric display properties
rules.reason: Six numeric properties map to Rust transform overrides. AS2 alpha/scale use percentages; AS3 uses scalar alpha/scale. AS2 setters Number-coerce before finite validation.
rules.limitations: Root transform setter is rejected; only active non-root placements receive overrides. AS3 setters require finite JS numbers; alpha must be in [0,1]. This is bounded host validation, not proof of Flash coercion semantics. rotation 370 reads back 370; Adobe AS3 documents normalization to 10.

rules.title: Timeline controls
rules.reason: Six timeline methods are exposed on every instance proxy. Frames are one-based and string labels resolve before numeric strings; an independent MovieClip or root timeline can be controlled.
rules.limitations: No AS3 scene parameter or scene model. Graphic/synchronized symbols do not have independent clocks. nextFrame/prevFrame clamp and stop. play/stop return a Boolean from WASM instead of documented void; observed play() => true. General Flash frame entry/reentrancy ordering is not established by differential tests.

rules.title: Trace
rules.reason: Injected trace writes prefixed values to console and a 160-character String-coerced feedback line. AS compiler redirects trace to captured host binding.
rules.limitations: Output transport and coercion are NeoFlash behavior. No original Flash coercion/output differential run.
